name: shellphone
description: Let Claude see what Claude Code has been doing in your local repos, and send instructions back.
long_description:
shellphone is a context bridge between Claude Code and Claude chat sessions, so you stop hand-carrying state between them.

While you work in Claude Code, it records a short digest of each stretch of work into `.shellphone/state.md` in your repo — what landed, what state it is in, what decision is open. It also records a standing manifest of what the project *is*: stack, layout, settled decisions and why they were settled, constraints, gotchas. This extension reads those files back, so you can ask "where is that project at?" in chat and get an accurate answer without pasting anything.

You can also send an instruction the other way. It lands in the repo's inbox and is surfaced at the start of your next Claude Code session in that repo, which shows it to you before acting on it.

Everything stays on your machine. shellphone moves state *about* code — status, decisions, open questions — never the code itself. There is no backend, no account, and no telemetry.

Requires the shellphone CLI and Claude Code hooks to be installed to produce digests; see the setup guide in the documentation.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List every repo shellphone knows about on this machine, with its branch, triage status, last activity, one-line description, and count of pending instructions.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Get everything shellphone knows about one repo: what the project is (its manifest) and what just changed (its recent session digests), in separate sections.

tools.name: get_queue_status
tools.description: Check whether Claude Code has picked up the instructions you sent to a repo — separately reporting whether each was shown to it and whether it was acted on.

tools.name: send_instruction
tools.description: Queue an instruction for Claude Code in a repo. It is surfaced at the start of the next session there and shown to the user before being acted on.

tools.name: record_digest
tools.description: Append a session digest to a repo's ledger. Called by Claude Code at the end of a stretch of work, not normally by a chat session.

tools.name: record_manifest
tools.description: Record what a project is — stack, layout, settled decisions, constraints, gotchas. Called by Claude Code after surveying a repo.
